title: Skull Paint Eruption
description: A cracked white skull sits centered on dark concentric ripples, its top open as a vibrant cascade of liquid paint in green, red, white, purple and yellow explodes upwards. Dark smoke and particles rise from the skull while glowing orbs and roots frame the surreal scene against a black background.
prompt: A cracked white human skull positioned in the center of dark concentric ripples on the ground, its cranium split open with a massive explosive splash of liquid paint erupting upwards in green, red, white, purple and yellow. Black and grey smoke rises from the skull, surrounded by glowing colorful orbs and dark tree roots in the background, surreal symbolic scene, dark atmosphere with high contrast
